rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record headed 平成１９年９月２５日（火）午前 says the cabinet meeting decided the resignation en masse (「内閣総辞職」について決定) and the 内閣総辞職に当たっての内閣総理大臣談話, and that 安倍総理 spoke at it on the resignation.
